subject: Nimbly Commerce: bank credentials + remittance sample for payee activation
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Emma Li <emma.li@nimblycommerce.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com, jonas.weber@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 3 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Payee activation — bank credentials + remit format

Hi Emma,

Thanks for choosing Redwood — excited to get Nimbly Commerce live. To complete vendor activation on our side we need the following so Finance can set up ACH / wire routing and remittance mapping: 

- Bank routing number, account number, account type (checking/savings)
- Legal business name on account and EIN (we have your W-9 listed but please reattach if updated)
- One voided check or bank letter (PDF)
- Example remittance payload (sample XML or CSV) showing invoice_number -> remit_reference mapping

If you prefer, you can copy in your bank rep and they can upload the voided check directly. Once Finance receives the docs we'll kick off the micro-deposit test (expected 1–2 business days) and confirm the remittance sample with payops.

Next steps / ask: please send the bank file + remit example, or let me know if you want Redwood to request a bank letter from your bank rep.

Appreciate it — happy to hop on a quick call today if helpful.

— Marcus
Marcus Lin
Senior Partnerships Manager, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0182

[Attachment: onboarding-checklist.pdf (pdf)]

From: Emma Li <emma.li@nimblycommerce.com>

Cc: Trevor Banks <trevor@banktide.com>
Date: Mon, 3 Aug 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Payee activation — bank credentials + remit format

Hi Marcus,

Thanks — attaching the files below. Trevor from BankTide (our payments bank) is on the thread and can confirm routing. Files attached: W9_NimblyCommerce.pdf, voided_check_nimbly.pdf, and a small sample remittance (remit-sample.xml).

Bank details: 
- Bank: BankTide, N.A.
- Routing: 122000247
- Account: ****6789 (checking) — full number on voided check
- Account name: Nimbly Commerce, Inc.
- EIN: 12-3456789

Remit sample notes: we currently include invoice number, invoice date, net_amount, remit_reference (PO#.invoice#) and a short description. Invoice numbering uses NIM-YYYY-#####. If Redwood needs a different remit_reference mapping please say which field you prefer.

Trevor — can you confirm micro-deposit timing and any additional verification BankTide needs?

Best,
Emma
Emma Li
Head of Finance, Nimbly Commerce
emma.li@nimblycommerce.com

[Attachment: W9_NimblyCommerce.pdf, voided_check_nimbly.pdf, remit-sample.xml]

From: Trevor Banks <trevor@banktide.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Emma Li <emma.li@nimblycommerce.com>
Date: Mon, 3 Aug 2026 14:27:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Payee activation — bank credentials + remit format

Hi Marcus (and team),

Confirmed — BankTide has received authorizations for micro-deposit verification and we can push a single micro-deposit of $0.12 to verify the account. Expected arrival: within 1 business day for same-day ACH clients, 2 business days otherwise. Please note wires require beneficiary name match and a bank letter for amounts over $25k on first outbound.

I attached a one-page bank letter template we can provide if Redwood needs it for wire pre-checks. Also: we recommend mapping your remit engine to the remit_reference field in the XML; PO#.invoice# looks good. If you need a CSV instead let me know and Emma can share.

— Trevor
Trevor Banks
Client Services, BankTide
trevor@banktide.com

[Attachment: banktide-letter-template.pdf]

> Bank details: 
> - Bank: BankTide, N.A.
> - Routing: 122000247
> - Account: ****6789 (checking) — full number on voided check
> - Account name: Nimbly Commerce, Inc.
> - EIN: 12-3456789

Thanks for the docs — Finance ran the initial verification and I can confirm the micro-deposit of $0.12 hit our test account at 08:04 AM today. We're marking the ACH route as verified in the payee profile. 

Jonas — can you please map the incoming remit XML so that remit_reference -> invoice.reference and PO#.invoice# remains the canonical key? Also add a note to reconcile NIM- prefixed invoice numbers.

Emma — we do have one small ask before we close: for automated wire payouts above $25k, can you either (a) provide the bank letter (Trevor offered template) or (b) confirm a signatory who can execute a wire authorization request? If you can upload the letter to the HubSpot company record or reply with the signed PDF we'll attach it to the vendor file and enable wire route.

If we don't hear back by EOD Thursday we'll enable ACH only and enable wire after the bank letter is in place.

Thanks —
Laura Bennett
Director, Finance Operations | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com
